ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment to high-intensity white mottling across visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Irregular high-contrast white mottling concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edges; central region near the median notch consists of solid low-intensity dark pigment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary with continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex upward curvature on both the left and right lobes terminating at pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters present on the far left and far right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal white linear disruption visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear white scar on the left lobe and circular scarring patterns on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian subject (seagull) partially occluding the background between the fluke lobes.
